zh.headline: 英伟达市值一周蒸发万亿，AI股入熊市
headline_alt: Anthropic 上市次日回吐涨幅，纳指 AI 板块承压
从黎曼猜想到本地小模型，AI 一日双线推进
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是“效率范式”同时在三层出现：字节用三个训练阶段证明数据质量可替代训练步数，英伟达研究者主张用摘要与检索替代超大上下文，Thinking Machines 用循环层让小模型在笔记本上跑出接近大模型的编码分数。与之对照，资本侧正在经历相反方向的收缩——纳指 AI 板块进入熊市、英伟达单周跌 14%、Anthropic 上市次日回吐涨幅，估值开始为过去一年的叙事定价。黎曼猜想同日出现 AI 与人类两版证明，则把一个更棘手的问题摆上台面：当 AI 产出超出人类核验速度，验证机制本身会成为瓶颈。对 builder 而言，短期最实际的三件事是 GPT-Live-1.1 的待机降价、Gemini 的 Tool Retrieval，以及 Inkling 2 Mini 这类可本地部署的高性价比模型。

items.title: 美股 AI 板块创疫情以来最大周跌幅
items.desc: 纳斯达克 100 进入熊市，英伟达单周跌 14%，SEC 正在审查其会计问题；Anthropic 上市次日几乎回吐全部涨幅。
items.value: 融资环境收紧，AI 公司估值逻辑面临重估

items.title: 黄仁勋离职风波持续发酵
items.desc: WIRED 报道称，英伟达董事会的核心关切是黄仁勋“缺乏坦诚”，涉及多起私人关系指控；公司同时宣布停止在中国销售 H200。
items.value: 算力供应链与对华政策不确定性上升

items.title: Anthropic IPO 承销行撤除稳价头寸
items.desc: 路透报道称，负责稳定股价的承销银行已平掉相关仓位，上市后价格支撑消失。
items.value: IPO 后股价波动风险由市场自行承担

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Live-1.1 语音模型
items.desc: 全双工语音模型改进多语言口音与转写，新增 standby 模式，空闲 WebRTC 计费从 $0.05/分钟降至 $0.02/分钟。
items.value: 语音 Agent 待机成本减半，长会话产品可行

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol 提示词模板
items.desc: 针对回答过短、多余追问、编码时过度测试等常见行为给出官方 prompt 模板；并提示编辑会话历史会丢弃 reasoning 内容、降低质量。
items.value: 直接影响线上 prompt 与多轮会话设计

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 刷新具身智能基准
items.desc: 16 项任务成功率较 GPT-6 Astra 翻倍，并首次完成可变形物体操控。
items.value: 通用模型在机器人任务上的能力边界外扩

items.title: 字节提出“多数训练阶段不必要”并开源 Axion 1.0
items.desc: 仅三个训练阶段即在基准上比肩 OpenAI / Anthropic 商用模型，研究团队将增益归因于精选数据而非更多训练步数，模型、数据、代码全部开放。
items.value: 数据质量优先的训练范式，可复现

items.title: Google 论文称内部已实现 RSI
items.desc: 提出将 Opus 经验喂给 Gemini、让模型拥有“进化记忆”，主张算力堆叠时代正在终结。
items.value: 递归自我改进路线图首次给出工程细节

items.title: Gemini API 上线 Tool Retrieval
items.desc: 工具数量多时可按需检索相关工具，而非全量注入上下文。
items.value: 大规模 MCP 工具集的上下文成本大幅下降

items.title: 联合国“杀手机器人”规则谈判无果
items.desc: 日内瓦会议一周磋商后，各方仅同意“开始讨论各种选项”。
items.value: 自主武器监管真空期延长

items.title: Anthropic 称 Claude 证明黎曼猜想，斯坦福同日发布纯人类竞争稿
items.desc: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 称借助 Claude 完成 25 万页 Lean 形式化证明；数小时后斯坦福发布独立全人工草稿，数学家正在核验两者。
items.value: AI 数学成果的验证标准成为新问题

items.title: 英伟达研究者称超大上下文窗口是死路
items.desc: 实验显示周期性摘要 + 关键词定向检索通常能以极低成本达到全上下文效果，并提出以“短笔记”替代长上下文的新模型类别。
items.value: 长上下文成本结构或被重新设计

items.title: System 1 agents：不生成文本的本地 Agent
items.desc: 确定性编译器把工具 schema 与请求转为多选题，模型只做选择不写文本，避免本地小模型幻觉值在工具调用链中传播，面向敏感临床数据分析。
items.value: 本地 Agent 可靠性的新架构范式

items.title: Baseten 发布 bison-1 / groundhog-1 决策模型
items.desc: 基于 Gemma 4 的开源权重决策模型，bison-1 在 AA Decision Index v2.1 得 76 分登顶，支持 128k 上下文与图像输入。
items.value: 结构化决策场景有了开源强基线

items.title: OpenAI 推出 MedChemBench
items.desc: 评估模型解读分子结构、从实验证据推理、在早期药物发现中筛选化合物的能力。
items.value: 药物发现场景有了统一评测口径

items.title: Thinking Machines 开源 Inkling 2 Mini
items.desc: 26.4B 参数 looped MoE、激活 3.4B，24 层中 12 层每 token 循环三次，可在 32GB Mac 或单台 DGX Spark 上运行，SWE-bench Verified 79.2%，Intelligence Index 与 Qwen3.8 27B 持平而成本约为其 1/6。
items.value: 笔记本可跑的高分编码模型，推理成本极低

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.desc: 面向 Stitch MCP server 的 Agent Skills 库，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor。
items.value: 跨编码 Agent 的技能复用有了官方实现

items.title: agent-mcts：在 Claude Code 之上做蒙特卡洛树搜索
items.desc: 用 MCTS 组织编码 Agent 的探索与回溯。
items.value: 给编码 Agent 增加搜索式推理骨架

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Cursor 等提供 45 种编辑级图表类型，输出自包含 HTML + SVG，明确反对 Mermaid 风格。
items.value: Agent 生成图表的质量可直接用于交付

items.title: “不要玩 Anthropic 的游戏”：AI 监管与 IPO 的利益纠葛被公开质疑
items.desc: NYT 观点文章批评 Anthropic 以安全叙事换取监管优势、再转化为 IPO 估值，在 HN 引发讨论；同期 The Verge 播客追问“Anthropic 真的负担得起安全优先吗”。争论焦点是：安全立场究竟是产品约束还是竞争壁垒。
items.value: 安全叙事与商业利益的边界正被公开审视

items.title: 私有开源权重模型的易用性成为 HN 热点
items.desc: 一篇实操指南演示普通人如何在本机跑私有开源权重模型，评论集中在本地部署的隐私收益与运维成本权衡。
items.value: 本地推理正从极客玩法转向常规选项

en.headline: Nvidia loses $1 trillion in market value in a week as AI stocks enter bear market
headline_alt: Anthropic gives back gains on second day of trading as Nasdaq AI sector comes under pressure
From the Riemann Hypothesis to local small models, AI advances on two fronts in a single day
en.observation: The clearest signal today is the "efficiency paradigm" appearing at three layers at once: ByteDance used three training stages to prove data quality can substitute for training steps, NVIDIA researchers argue for replacing ultra-large context with summaries and retrieval, and Thinking Machines used recurrent layers to let a small model achieve coding scores close to large models on a laptop. In contrast, the capital side is undergoing a contraction in the opposite direction—the Nasdaq AI sector has entered a bear market, NVIDIA fell 14% in a single week, and Anthropic gave back its gains the day after listing, as valuations begin to price in the past year's narrative. The Riemann Hypothesis receiving both an AI and a human proof on the same day puts a thornier question on the table: when AI output exceeds human verification speed, the verification mechanism itself becomes the bottleneck. For builders, the three most practical things in the short term are the standby price cut for GPT-Live-1.1, Gemini's Tool Retrieval, and cost-effective locally deployable models like Inkling 2 Mini.

items.title: US AI stocks post biggest weekly drop since the pandemic
items.desc: The Nasdaq 100 has entered a bear market, Nvidia fell 14% in a single week, and the SEC is reviewing its accounting issues; Anthropic gave back almost all of its gains the day after its listing.
items.value: Tightening financing conditions force a re-rating of AI valuations

items.title: The Jensen Huang resignation fallout continues
items.desc: WIRED reports that the Nvidia board's core concern was Huang's "lack of candor," involving multiple allegations about personal relationships; the company also announced it will stop selling the H200 in China.
items.value: Rising uncertainty in the compute supply chain and China policy

items.title: Anthropic IPO underwriters close stabilization position
items.desc: Reuters reports that the underwriting banks responsible for stabilizing the share price have closed their positions, removing post-IPO price support.
items.value: Post-IPO price volatility risk now falls entirely on the market

items.title: OpenAI releases the GPT-Live-1.1 voice model
items.desc: The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, adds a standby mode, and cuts idle WebRTC billing from $0.05/min to $0.02/min.
items.value: Voice agent standby costs halve, making long-session products viable

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol prompt templates
items.desc: Official prompt templates address common behaviors such as overly short answers, unnecessary follow-up questions, and excessive testing during coding; OpenAI also warns that editing session history discards reasoning content and lowers quality.
items.value: Directly affects production prompts and multi-turn session design

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra sets new embodied AI benchmark records
items.desc: Its success rate on 16 tasks doubles that of GPT-6 Astra, and it completes deformable-object manipulation for the first time.
items.value: General models extend their capability boundary on robotics tasks

items.title: ByteDance argues "most training phases are unnecessary" and open-sources Axion 1.0
items.desc: With only three training phases it matches commercial models from OpenAI / Anthropic on benchmarks; the research team attributes the gains to curated data rather than more training steps, and releases the model, data, and code in full.
items.value: A data-quality-first training paradigm that is reproducible

items.title: Google paper claims RSI has been achieved internally
items.desc: It proposes feeding Opus experience into Gemini so the model has "evolutionary memory," arguing that the era of stacking compute is ending.
items.value: First engineering details for a recursive self-improvement roadmap

items.title: Gemini API launches Tool Retrieval
items.desc: When there are many tools, relevant tools can be retrieved on demand instead of injecting the full set into context.
items.value: Context costs for large-scale MCP tool sets drop sharply

items.title: UN "killer robot" rules talks end without agreement
items.desc: After a week of consultations in Geneva, parties only agreed to "begin discussing the various options."
items.value: The regulatory vacuum on autonomous weapons is extended

items.title: Anthropic says Claude proved the Riemann Hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft the same day
items.desc: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says Claude was used to complete a 250,000-page Lean formal proof; hours later Stanford released an independent fully human draft, and mathematicians are verifying both.
items.value: Verification standards for AI math results become a new problem

items.title: Nvidia researchers say huge context windows are a dead end
items.desc: Experiments show periodic summarization + keyword-targeted retrieval usually achieves full-context results at extremely low cost, and they propose a new model class using "short notes" instead of long context.
items.value: Long-context cost structure may be redesigned

items.title: System 1 agents: local agents that do not generate text
items.desc: A deterministic compiler turns tool schemas and requests into multiple-choice questions; the model only selects and does not write text, preventing hallucinated values from local small models from propagating through tool-call chains, aimed at sensitive clinical data analysis.
items.value: A new architectural paradigm for local agent reliability

items.title: Baseten releases bison-1 / groundhog-1 decision models
items.desc: Open-weight decision models based on Gemma 4; bison-1 scores 76 on AA Decision Index v2.1 to top the ranking, supports 128k context and image input.
items.value: Structured decision scenarios gain a strong open-source baseline

items.title: OpenAI launches MedChemBench
items.desc: Evaluates models' ability to interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and screen compounds in early drug discovery.
items.value: Drug discovery gains a unified evaluation standard

items.title: Thinking Machines open-sources Inkling 2 Mini
items.desc: A 26.4B-parameter looped MoE with 3.4B active parameters, where 12 of 24 layers loop three times per token; it runs on a 32GB Mac or a single DGX Spark, scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified, and matches Qwen3.8 27B on the Intelligence Index at about 1/6 the cost.
items.value: A high-scoring coding model that runs on a laptop at very low inference cost

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.desc: An Agent Skills library for the Stitch MCP server that follows the Agent Skills open standard and is compatible with Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.
items.value: Cross-agent skill reuse now has an official implementation

items.title: agent-mcts: Monte Carlo tree search on top of Claude Code
items.desc: Uses MCTS to organize exploration and backtracking for coding agents.
items.value: Adds a search-based reasoning scaffold to coding agents

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.desc: Provides 45 editorial-grade diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and others, outputs self-contained HTML + SVG, and explicitly rejects the Mermaid style.
items.value: Agent-generated diagrams are now deliverable-quality

items.title: "Don't play Anthropic's game": the entanglement of AI regulation and IPO interests is publicly questioned
items.desc: A NYT opinion piece criticizes Anthropic for trading a safety narrative for regulatory advantage and then converting it into IPO valuation, sparking discussion on HN; meanwhile a The Verge podcast asks "can Anthropic really afford safety first." The debate centers on whether the safety stance is a product constraint or a competitive moat.
items.value: The line between safety narrative and business interest is under public scrutiny

items.title: Ease of use of private open-weight models becomes an HN hot topic
items.desc: A hands-on guide shows how ordinary people can run private open-weight models locally, with comments focused on weighing the privacy benefits of local deployment against operational costs.
items.value: Local inference is shifting from geek hobby to mainstream option
